title: RUNE Ethereum Bridge Guide with SushiSwap!
description: This video explains the new RUNE Bridge created by THORChain and shows you how to add ERC-20 RUNE into a liquidity pool on SushiSwap!  RUNE is now an ERC-20 token on the Ethereum Blockchain and the RUNE Bridge allows a person to transfer their BEP-2 Token to an ERC-20 Token.  Additionally three liquidity pools have been created on SushiSwap that allows a person to provide RUNE into the pools, with a corresponding asset.   Timeline 0:00 Introduction 0:26 Rune ERC-20 Token 1:30 The process to follow 2:00 Moving BEP-20 Rune to ERC-20 RUNE 3:20 Adding RUNE ERC-20 Token to MetaMask 4:12 SushSwap Pools 4:40 Connecting a Ethereum Wallet 5:14 Approve SushiSwap to spend Rune 5:47 Adding to the pool in SushiSwap 6:45 Post adding to the pool 6:58 Things to be aware of 7:46 Summary  Links used in the video: https://bitcoin-sage.medium.com/using-the-rune-bridge-to-provide-liquidity-on-sushiswap-4ac852ebfcbe https://sushiswap.vision/token/0x3155ba85d5f96b2d030a4966af206230e46849cb https://sushiswap.fi/pair/0xcc39592f5cb193a70f262aa301f54db1d600e6da https://runebridge.org/pools https://exchange.sushiswapclassic.org/#/add/ETH/0x3155BA85D5F96b2d030a4966AF206230e46849cb https://chaosnet.bepswap.com/pools https://etherscan.io/token/0x3155ba85d5f96b2d030a4966af206230e46849cb https://etherscan.io/address/0x3155ba85d5f96b2d030a4966af206230e46849cb#code https://gitlab.com/thorchain/ethereum/eth-bridge/-/blob/master/contracts/eth_rune.sol  Also see https://youtu.be/Y-5v6EOHyBA for more information.
